Web goes to the collection of music, putting away the other record. They pick through the collection until their eyes light up. "Oh, they have it!"
Web pulls a record out and sets it on the player. "I used to listen to this one all the time. Mine was water damaged though, so I never got to listen to the whole thing."
Web goes over to Baeshra and holds her in a different position. "It's going to be a little faster and more dramatic, okay?"
Baeshra nods firmly, but apprehensively. "Okay Web."
"You'll get it. It took me ages to learn this stuff at first."
Baeshra takes a deep breath before the music begins.
The music starts. It is a bolero piece that starts out slowly but begins to pick up some speed, moving more sweepingly.
Web gently guides her through the motions in a dance step that involves more movement, but is not actually that much more complex
(take advantage Web's helping)
Baeshra tries her best but trips over her tail a couple of times on some of the larger movements.
Web smiles as she begins to get into the rhythm. As it slows down towards the middle of the piece they smile. "You're doing very well for your first time."
"Web teach good."
She says softly while her brow is a furrowed trying to keep to keep up.
Web grins. "I'm glad you think so. You're my first pupil."
as the music begins to pick up again Web looks at her. "You ready?"
"No... but Baeshra try." She says with a firm nod.
